g.text: AFTER MVP — Proposed independent Git, execution and deployment admission
native transfer / exact revision-bound merge intent
actual native ref result or conflict
attributable exact code / definition event context
current run authority + isolation / resource / secret gates
no admitted execution; actual gate finding
target approval / artifact / configuration / recovery context
current target authority + guarded approval inputs
Associations and events convey no inherited permissions.
No automatic deploy from merge or run success.
Concrete coordination follows owning component contracts.
